newsitem.title: UK: Psion share placing to raise 14 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Psion share placing to raise 14 mln stg.

text.p: Psion Plc said on Thursday that is placing 3.5 million new ordinary shares at 400p per share to raise around 14 million stg, which will be used to expand the business in 1997 and beyond.

Psion, which develops and markets personal computers, modems and applications software, said demand across its main geographic markets is ahead of expectations and that current trading performance is on target.
David Potter, chairman of Psion, said, "Psion has seen strong growth continue in the second half. Demand for the new products has been good across all markets and the outlook is encouraging."
It said the new shares represent around five percent of the firm's issued ordinary share capital and that dealings are expected will commence on November 19.
